a gloomy outlook: With fewer tourists every year, the hotel owners have a gloomy outlook for the coming summer.
由於觀光客一年比一年少，飯店業者對即將到來的夏天抱持黯淡的前景。
gloomy predictions: Despite gloomy predictions that the team would lose, they won the final by three points.
儘管有人悲觀地預測這支隊伍會輸，他們仍以三分之差贏得決賽。
a gloomy mood: The dark clouds and endless rain put the whole class in a gloomy mood all afternoon.
烏雲和下個不停的雨讓全班整個下午都處於憂鬱的心情中。
gloomy weather: After a week of gloomy weather with gray skies and cold rain, everyone was happy to see the sun.
經過一週灰濛濛又下著冷雨的陰沉天氣後，大家看到太陽都很開心。
a glorious victory: The whole country celebrated the baseball team's glorious victory in the world championship last night.
全國都在慶祝昨晚棒球隊在世界冠軍賽中光榮的勝利。
glorious weather: We had absolutely glorious weather for our picnic, with warm sunshine and a clear blue sky.
我們野餐那天天氣極好，陽光溫暖，天空湛藍無雲。
a glorious past: The old port city is proud of its glorious past, when ships from all over the world stopped there.
這座古老的港口城市以其輝煌的過去為傲，當時世界各地的船隻都在此停靠。
a glorious mess: After the children baked cookies, the kitchen was a glorious mess of flour, sugar, and broken eggs.
孩子們烤完餅乾後，廚房裡麵粉、糖和破蛋到處都是，亂成一團。
a gorgeous view: From our hotel balcony, we had a gorgeous view of the sun setting over the sea.
從我們飯店的陽台，可以看到夕陽沉入海中的美極了的景色。
gorgeous weather: It's gorgeous weather today, so let's take the kids to the beach before it gets too crowded.
今天天氣絕佳，我們趁海灘還沒太擁擠前帶孩子們去吧。
look gorgeous: You look absolutely gorgeous in that red dress; everyone at the party will notice you.
你穿那件紅洋裝看起來美極了，派對上每個人都會注意到你。
a graceful exit: After twenty years in the job, the manager made a graceful exit, thanking every worker personally.
在這份工作待了二十年後，經理親自感謝每位員工，優雅體面地退場。
a graceful apology: Instead of making excuses, the coach gave a graceful apology that impressed both players and fans.
教練沒有找藉口，而是做了一次有風度的道歉，讓球員和球迷都很佩服。
graceful movements: The swan's graceful movements across the quiet lake looked just like a ballet dancer's.
天鵝在寧靜湖面上優美的動作看起來就像芭蕾舞者一樣。
a gracious host: Mrs. Lin was a gracious host who made sure every guest had enough food and felt at home.
林太太是位親切有禮的主人，確保每位客人都吃得飽且感到賓至如歸。
a gracious loser: Although he lost the final, he was a gracious loser and warmly shook the winner's hand.
雖然他輸了決賽，他是個有風度的輸家，熱情地和贏家握手。
gracious living: The magazine shows gracious living in big houses with beautiful gardens and expensive furniture.
這本雜誌展示住在有美麗花園和昂貴家具的大房子裡的優渥的生活。
Good gracious!: "Good gracious! What happened to your arm?" Grandma cried when she saw the big bandage.
「天哪！你的手臂怎麼了？」奶奶看到那一大塊繃帶時叫道。
a grammatical error: My teacher circled another grammatical error in my essay because I wrote "he go" instead of "he goes."
老師在我的作文裡又圈出一個文法錯誤，因為我把「he goes」寫成了「he go」。
grammatically correct: Your sentence is grammatically correct because the verb agrees with the subject, but it sounds a bit unnatural.
你的句子文法正確，因為動詞和主詞一致，但聽起來有點不自然。
grammatical rules: Instead of just memorizing grammatical rules, try reading English stories to see how the language is really used.
與其只背文法規則，不如試著讀英文故事，看看這個語言實際上是怎麼使用的。
a graphic description: The reporter gave a graphic description of the car accident that made some readers feel sick.
記者對那場車禍做了生動逼真的描述，讓一些讀者感到不舒服。
graphic violence: The movie is only for adults because it contains a lot of graphic violence and blood.
這部電影只限成人觀看，因為裡面有大量血腥露骨的暴力畫面和血。
graphic design: My cousin studies graphic design and creates posters and logos for small companies in her free time.
我表姊念平面設計，空閒時間為小公司設計海報和標誌。
in graphic detail: The witness described the robbery in graphic detail, so the police could picture exactly what happened.
目擊者以逼真的細節描述了這起搶案，讓警方能清楚想像出事發經過。
be grateful to someone for: I will always be grateful to my English teacher for helping me prepare for the speech contest.
我會永遠因英文老師幫助我準備演講比賽而感謝她。
be deeply grateful: The family wanted everyone to know they are deeply grateful for the help they received after the fire.
這家人想讓大家知道，他們對火災後得到的幫助深為感激。
I would be grateful if you could…: I would be grateful if you could send me more information about the summer English camp.
如果您能寄給我更多關於暑期英文營的資訊，我將不勝感激。
